author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಇಳೆಸೀಳಿ ಹೊರಬರುವ ಮೊಳಕೆಯಂದದಿ ಬದುಕು
ಉಳಿವುದಕೆ ಹೋರಾಟ ಅಡೆತಡೆಯ ಸರಿಸಿ
ಕಳೆ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಬೆಳೆವಂತೆ ಕಷ್ಟನಷ್ಟವ ಸಹಿಸೆ
ಗಳಿಸುನೀ ಶಕ್ತಿಯನು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Life is like a sprout that splits the earth and comes out;
it fights to survive, pushing obstacles aside;
as crops grow along with weeds, bear hardship and loss,
and gather your strength, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Written on Yugādi, the Kannada New Year. Like a seedling breaking through soil, we must push through obstacles; like a crop growing amid weeds, bear hardship and grow strong.
